ref_file_title: CS99 - Signature Schemes Based on the Strong RSA Assumption
note: cryptobib key CCS:CraSho99 (title, authors, pages 46-51, DOI verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib; ACM DL and eprint 1999/001 records confirmed via search snippets). Journal version: ACM TISSEC 3(3):161-185, 2000 (doi 10.1145/357830.357847). EUF-CMA in the standard model under strong RSA plus a collision-resistant hash; the proof splits forgers into three types by whether the forgery reuses a signing exponent.

ref_file_title: DF02 - A Statistically-Hiding Integer Commitment Scheme Based on Groups with Hidden Order
note: cryptobib key AC:DamFuj02 (title, authors, pages 125-142, LNCS 2501, DOI verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib; Springer/Aarhus records confirmed via search snippets). Generalizes FO97 to any abelian group whose order is hidden from the committer; binding under the strong root assumption (strong RSA in Z_n^*) plus a mild structural assumption on the group; fills gaps in the soundness proofs of FO97's associated protocols.
